items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was Tommy Benford [phonetic] on drums.

ctx.x: It might have, but I don’t remember any comments being made.

I would be remiss if I didn’t bring up the historic recording session of April 1937 in Paris with the four saxophones, the first time you worked with just a saxophone group like that. Your friend, Coleman Hawkins, was the other American on the tape. Well, actually, there were two. There was Tommy Benford [phonetic] on drums.
